claim: The 50th Academy of Country Music Awards took place on Sunday night at the Dallas Cowboys stadium, making it the biggest ACM Awards yet.
best_evidence_window: (Billboard)Considering the Academy of Country Music Awards celebrated its 50th anniversary on Sunday night at the Dallas Cowboys stadium, it was bound to be bigger than any previous year's ACMs. Plus, as hosts Blake Shelton and Luke Bryan were quick to point out, everything is bigger in Texas.

claim: The event had its highs and lows, with some standout moments.
best_evidence_window: Here's our breakdown of the 10 best and 5 worst moments at the 2015 ACMs. Eric Church & Keith Urban provide an opening wallop.

claim: Eric Church and Keith Urban kicked off the show with a powerful performance, setting the tone for the night.
best_evidence_window: Eric Church & Keith Urban provide an opening wallop. With a full stadium and millions of home viewers watching, two of country's leading men successfully lit the fuse for the 50th annual ACM Awards with a slick joint kickoff performance.

claim: The ACM Awards also set a Guinness World Record for the biggest audience for a live TV awards show ever.
best_evidence_window: Setting a Guinness World Record. Not only was this the ACMs biggest audience ever, but the 2015 ACM Awards brought in the biggest audience for a live TV awards show ever.

claim: Reba McEntire showcased her vocal prowess and proved why she is a country legend.
best_evidence_window: Reba is eternal. Taylor Swift singing in the audience.

claim: Taylor Swift, despite her transition to pop music, showed her love for country by singing along to the performances.
best_evidence_window: Whether it was during Eric Church or Martina McBride, T-Swift was heating up the audience by singing and swaying along to country staples. Taylor might have gone pop for "1989," but she was deep in the heart of Texas for this annual country extravaganza.

claim: Garth Brooks paid tribute to the U.S.
best_evidence_window: Billboard: 2015 ACM Awards: And the Winners Are... Garth Brooks' All-American salute.

claim: armed forces and his home state of Oklahoma in an emotional moment.
best_evidence_window: armed forces "who are here and are all around the world for protecting our freedom," and also shouted out his home state of Oklahoma, who are grieving 20 years after the Oklahoma City bombing on Sunday. A truly classy moment from one of the best ever.

claim: Taylor Swift's mother made an appearance to present her daughter with a special award, a poignant moment given her recent cancer diagnosis.
best_evidence_window: Sure, Andrea Swift's presentation of a special award for her daughter came with a fun origin tale about the creation of "Love Story" and some lovely words about the 25-year-old superstar. But the sight of the elder Swift -- just days after Taylor confirmed that her mother had been diagnosed with cancer -- walking to the podium was more than enough to yield one of the night's most poignant moments.

claim: Christina Aguilera surprised with a guest performance alongside Rascal Flatts.
best_evidence_window: Aguilera is far from country, but with a voice as malleable as hers, she can pass for a song or two. After singing a bit of the tune she did while guesting on Nashville, Xtina joined longtime hitmakers Rascal Flatts for "Riot" from their recent album "Rewind." Aguilera and Gary LeVox trading vocals was the rare unexpected artist pairing that actually worked.

claim: Miranda Lambert had a successful night, both in terms of her performance and winning awards.
best_evidence_window: Miranda Lambert domination. In addition to kicking ass during her "Mama's Broken Heart"/"Little Red Wagon" medley, Lambert justly owned the night when it came to awards.

claim: Little Big Town performed their controversial song "Girl Crush" and Jason Aldean delivered a strong vocal performance.
best_evidence_window: Despite some mild controversy over their song "Girl Crush," Little Big Town brought the poignant ballad to the awards show, giving the ACMs one of its more melancholy moments. Jason Aldean comes on strong.

claim: However, there were also some low points, such as Tony Romo's stiffness on the mic and the excessive length of the show.
best_evidence_window: It's hard to see an audience get weak in the knees when you're watching at home, but it's fair to assume that's what happened during his performance. The Dallas Cowboys QB was understandably a little stiff on the mic (athletes usually aren't the most charismatic public speakers) but the whole gag with Shelton asking Romo to toss Bryan a pass went on waaaaay too long.

claim: Some fans on Twitter criticized Taylor Swift for attending the ACMs after transitioning to pop music, but it was noted that she still has a significant impact on the country genre.
best_evidence_window: Plenty of country fans went after T-Swizzle on Twitter, berating her for attending the ACMs after "abandoning" country music for pop. The truth is, Swift has just as many country classics under her belt as any other artist in her age range.

claim: Overall, the 50th ACM Awards had its ups and downs, but it was a memorable and significant milestone for the country music community.
best_evidence_window: Taylor Swift was given an extended honor at this year's ACM Awards, but some of the Milestone Awards -- especially those given to Reba McEntire, Kenny Chesney and George Strait -- seemed rushed for the country giants they were saluting. It's understandable since 2015 is the 50th anniversary of the ACMs, but sometimes, less (recipients) is more.
